title: [Tb4(OH)4]-Cuboid Complex Dianion Stabilized with Six Carboxylate Bridges and Four Diketonate Caps

material_class.structural_family: hydroxo-bridged [Tb4(OH)4] cubane cluster salt with [Ni(hfac)(2pyIN)2]+ counter cations

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by a modified one-pot method for lanthanide–nitroxide complexes. A heptane solution (20 mL) containing [Tb(hfac)3(H2O)2] (40.3 mg, 0.049 mmol) was refluxed and concentrated to ca. 2 mL. Separately, a heptane suspension (20 mL) containing Ni(CF3CO2)2·4H2O (19.3 mg, 0.054 mmol) was refluxed and concentrated to ca. 2 mL. Both were cooled to ca. 40 °C and poured into a dichloromethane solution (1.5 mL) of 2pyIN (21.7 mg, 0.10 mmol). The combined solution was immediately filtered and the filtrate was allowed to stand at −22 °C. After 3 days, orange polycrystalline 1 was collected, washed with heptane, and air-dried.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: one-pot mixing of concentrated heptane solutions with CH2Cl2 ligand solution, filtration, freezer crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: combined solution filtered; filtrate stood in a freezer (−22 °C) for 3 days; orange polycrystalline precipitates separated, washed with heptane, and air-dried

properties.summary: Dc susceptibility of 1 is nearly temperature-insensitive, indicating magnetically isolated complex ions and negligible Tb–O–Tb 4f–4f superexchange. χmT at 300 K is 50.5 cm3 K mol−1 (theory 50.7). On cooling, χmT decreases to 45.6 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K, attributed largely to Tb3+ crystal-field depopulation; 2p–3d coupling in the Ni cations is expected to be ferromagnetic but could not be quantified. Magnetization at 1.8 K reaches 34.4 NA μB at 7 T versus a theoretical maximum of 44 NA μB, remaining unsaturated because of Tb3+ anisotropy. No appreciable out-of-phase ac susceptibility was observed at 0, 1000, or 2000 Oe dc bias, consistent with the absence of SMM behavior for this Tb cuboid.

measurements.name: χmT
measurements.conditions: 300 K; dc field 500 Oe; polycrystalline sample fixed with eicosane

measurements.name: ac out-of-phase susceptibility χ″
measurements.conditions: no dc field; also 1000 and 2000 Oe applied dc fields
